requirements.quote: capable of disconnecting the transformer fuses from their voltage source and removing them from the structure.
requirements.text: Transformer fuses must be disconnectable and removable.

requirements.quote: This removing mechanism shall be so arranged that full access to the transformers cannot be accomplished until fuses are disconnected from the structure and grounded.
requirements.text: Access to transformers requires fuses to be disconnected and grounded.

requirements.quote: When moved to a full out position, the transformer fuses and VT windings shall be automatically connected to a ground stud.
requirements.text: Transformer fuses and VT windings must ground automatically when fully extended.

requirements.quote: Primary contacts shall be insulated from the structure by porcelain or cycloaliphatic epoxy supports, shall be self-aligning, and shall have silver to silver contact surfaces.
requirements.text: Primary contacts must be insulated, self-aligning, and have silver contact surfaces.

requirements.quote: VT’s shall be of the ratio indicated on the Contract Drawings and shall comply with ANSI C57.13.
requirements.text: VTs must match specified ratios and comply with ANSI C57.13.

requirements.quote: Current transformers shall be of the multi-ratio window type with ratios as indicated on the Contract Drawings.
requirements.text: CTs must be multi-ratio window type and match specified ratios.

requirements.quote: They shall have sufficient thermal and mechanical capacity to withstand the maximum momentary current rating of the breakers.
requirements.text: CTs must handle maximum momentary current rating.

requirements.quote: The secondary terminals shall be of the solder-less clamp type.
requirements.text: CT secondary terminals must be solder-less clamp type.

requirements.quote: All current transformers shall be properly identified for polarity with standard marking symbols.
requirements.text: CTs must have standard polarity markings.

requirements.quote: CT’s having a insulation rating of 15kV with fully insulated bus centered in the transformer window opening, are acceptable when corona, hypot, and impulse tests prove a satisfactory arrangement.
requirements.text: 15kV CTs are acceptable if tests confirm satisfactory arrangement.

requirements.quote: Tests shall be performed on a similar CT installation in the switchgear MANUFACTURER’s equipment and certified test reports shall be submitted with the approval drawings when requested.
requirements.text: Submit certified test reports for similar CT installations upon request.

requirements.quote: The minimum acceptable accuracy class for metering and relaying shall be in accordance with the latest edition of ANSI Standard C37.20.2 and C57.13.
requirements.text: CT accuracy class must meet ANSI C37.20.2 and C57.13.

requirements.quote: Phase CT’s shall be mounted over stationary primary disconnects.
requirements.text: Phase CTs must be mounted over stationary primary disconnects.

requirements.quote: Provide two KWH meter socket for Form 9S meter. KWH meter provided by others.
requirements.text: Provide two Form 9S KWH meter sockets.

requirements.quote: Provide (1) Test Switch assembly, with (3) current test jack and short-circuiting current assemblies and (4) single-pole potential assemblies, similar to States Type FMS-10E2.
requirements.text: Provide specified test switch assembly similar to States Type FMS-10E2.

requirements.quote: Miscellaneous interlock contacts and auxiliary relays as required for the breaker control scheme.
requirements.text: Include interlock contacts and auxiliary relays for breaker control.

requirements.quote: Two sets of control power circuit fuses for each breaker. Electrical control scheme shall be similar to ANSI C37.11, Figure 1, Diagram B, 2 with the trip and close circuits individually protected.
requirements.text: Provide two control power circuit fuses per breaker with ANSI C37.11 compliant scheme.

requirements.quote: Provide spare fuses for other control circuits (no less than two each).
requirements.text: Provide at least two spare fuses for control circuits.

requirements.quote: Cell switches in each compartment to bypass all breaker-mounted auxiliary switch "b" contacts when circuit breaker is removed.
requirements.text: Include cell switches to bypass auxiliary switch "b" contacts when breaker is removed.

requirements.quote: Include at least two spare "a" and two spare "b" contacts on each breaker cell position switch.
requirements.text: Provide two spare "a" and "b" contacts per breaker cell position switch.

requirements.quote: All breaker auxiliary and cell switch spare contacts wired out to compartment external connection terminal block.
requirements.text: Wire all spare contacts to external terminal block.

requirements.quote: Control designed such that breakers will not trip on interruption to DC control power.
requirements.text: Design control to prevent breaker trips on DC power interruption.

requirements.quote: Completely factory-install all internal control wiring.
requirements.text: Factory-install all internal control wiring.

requirements.quote: Switchgear secondary wiring shall be multi-stranded, tinned, copper conductor, type SIS, 600 volt, VW-1 rating. Minimum wire size shall be #14 AWG, 41 strand.
requirements.text: Secondary wiring must meet specified standards and sizes.

requirements.quote: BCT wiring shall be #10 AWG. Signal wiring (transducer outputs, etc.) shall be #22 twisted shielded pair. RTU connections shall be #18 AWG, 18 strand, type SIS.
requirements.text: BCT, signal, and RTU wiring must meet specified sizes and types.

requirements.quote: Splicing or tapping is not permitted.
requirements.text: No splicing or tapping allowed in wiring.

requirements.quote: Wiring between hinged and stationary panels shall be supported to prevent undue stress and shall be protected from contact with metal edges by suitable protective wrap.
requirements.text: Support and protect wiring between hinged and stationary panels.
